# Fixed: A queued rescan no longer fails when one of its artists was deleted

Part of the [custom Lidarr image](https://github.com/chodeus/Lidarr/tree/custom) (`ghcr.io/chodeus/lidarr:custom`), which merges this branch into `develop`. Reviewed in [#58](https://github.com/chodeus/Lidarr/pull/58).

A rescan command names the artists it is for by id. `DiskScanService.Scan` read them back with `GetArtists`, which throws when an id is no longer stored, and also when one is repeated, and it did so after walking its folders. Commands wait in a queue, and a delete through the API or the UI doesn't, so an artist deleted before or during the scan failed it for every artist on it. By then the scan had already cleaned the database rows of files missing from its folders, so nothing was imported or matched in that run.

- The scan reads its artists once, before any folder is cleaned, in one query that returns only the artists still stored, once each (`IArtistService.GetStoredArtists`, backed by `IArtistRepository.FindStored`; both have default bodies, so other implementations keep compiling). A scan with no artist ids is unchanged.
- The artists are used to report skipped artists, to check for missing artist folders, and to publish an `ArtistScannedEvent` for each when the scan completes. One deleted while the scan runs is still on that list, so it may be reported or its folder checked, but the scan reads the stored artists again before the completion events and leaves it out: those events' handlers write extra and metadata files into the artist's folder. The scan doesn't fail.

Tests: `ScanDeletedArtistFixture` runs the scan against the real `ArtistService` and repository over the test database; the disk, import decisions and media files are mocked. A scan naming a deleted artist still checks the stored artist's folder and makes its import decisions, as does one whose artist is deleted while it reads the folders; a missing root folder reports only the stored artist as skipped, and an artist named twice is checked once; an artist deleted while the folders are read gets no completion event while the others do. All four fail on `develop`, the mid-scan one also with the ids filtered only at the start; leaving out the stored-artist query, or the second read before the completion events, fails a test. The two `UpgradeMediaFileServiceFixture` tests that fail in a Debug build on a stray warning fail on `develop` too.
